description: Source code implementing ElevenLabs text-to-speech (TTS) services, including WebSocket and HTTP-based APIs, with support for streaming audio, word timestamps, voice customization, and context management.

classes.name: PronunciationDictionaryLocator
classes.description: Model representing a pronunciation dictionary locator with ID and version.

classes.name: ElevenLabsTTSService
classes.description: WebSocket-based real-time TTS service supporting word timestamps and context management.

classes.name: ElevenLabsHttpTTSService
classes.description: HTTP-based TTS service supporting word timestamps, for simpler integration without WebSocket.

classes.name: ElevenLabsTTSService.InputParams
classes.description: Configuration parameters for ElevenLabs WebSocket TTS, including language, voice settings, and parsing options.

classes.name: ElevenLabsHttpTTSService.InputParams
classes.description: Configuration parameters for ElevenLabs HTTP TTS, including language, latency, and voice settings.
